title: Hi, I'm $t(common:site.displayName)
description:
I'm a software engineering master's student who loves open source and sharing what I build.
I'm working to grow into an engineer who ships products with genuinely better user experiences.
I'm especially interested in AI infrastructure across the stack and in agent-based systems, and I'm actively learning and exploring both.

Thank you for visiting. I hope you might become my teacher and my friend.
This site is still under construction. Some content may be incomplete or incorrect, and I appreciate your understanding.
